provider.name: Mammal Diversity Database
provider.organization_type: global mammal taxonomy, nomenclature, classification, synonymy, distribution, conservation-crosswalk, bibliography, API, download, and curation infrastructure
provider.description: The Mammal Diversity Database is a global, versioned taxonomic resource for living and recently extinct mammals. It provides accepted names, classification from Mammalia through subspecies, authorship, synonyms, taxonomic notes, species counts, distributions, conservation crosswalks, references, taxonomic changes, persistent identifiers, downloads, APIs, release history, and editorial provenance.
institutional_context: MDD editors, taxonomic specialists, museum and university researchers
Global mammalogy, biodiversity informatics, conservation, and nomenclature communities
Related checklist, specimen, sequence, occurrence, phylogenetic, and conservation infrastructures

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting Mammal Diversity Database documentation, taxonomy, scientific and common names, hierarchy, synonyms, authorship, type data, distributions, conservation crosswalks, references, changes, releases, identifiers, APIs, downloads, schemas, licenses, citations, editorial methods, institutions, and related authorities.
purpose.authoritative_notice: MDD, the American Society of Mammalogists, official release files, editorial decisions, cited taxonomic publications, official API documentation, and source authorities remain authoritative for accepted names, hierarchy, synonymy, species counts, identifiers, versions, legal conditions, and contacts.
